properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 12 at 9:34AM EDT until September 12 at 12:30PM EDT by NWS Peachtree City GA
properties.description:
FFWFFC

The National Weather Service in Peachtree City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northwestern Douglas County in north central Georgia...
Northeastern Carroll County in northwestern Georgia...

* Until 1230 PM EDT.

* At 934 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 4 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Villa Rica, Lake Val-Do-Mar and Winston.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 12:30 PM EDT. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 12:30 PM EDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 12 at 9:16AM CDT until September 12 at 9:45AM CDT by NWS Hastings NE
properties.description:
At 916 AM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line from 9
miles south of Waco to near Geneva, moving east at 45 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

This severe thunderstorm will be near...
Exeter, Geneva and Fairmont around 920 AM CDT.
Milligan and Ohiowa around 930 AM CDT.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. These storms are capable of producing damaging winds and
large hail.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 12 at 9:19AM CDT until September 12 at 10:00AM CDT by NWS Omaha/Valley NE
properties.description:
SVROAX

The National Weather Service in Omaha has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southern Seward County in southeastern Nebraska...
Saline County in southeastern Nebraska...

* Until 1000 AM CDT.

* At 918 AM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 4 miles southwest of Utica to near Strang, moving
east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Severe thunderstorms will be near...
Beaver Crossing and Cordova around 925 AM CDT.
Friend and Goehner around 930 AM CDT.
Tobias around 935 AM CDT.

This includes Interstate 80 in Nebraska between mile markers 366 and
388.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 12 at 8:47AM CDT until September 12 at 9:45AM CDT by NWS Mobile AL
properties.description:
SMWMOB

The National Weather Service in Mobile has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Okaloosa-Walton County Line to Pensacola FL out
20 NM...
Coastal waters from Pensacola FL to Pascagoula MS out 20 NM...
Waters from Okaloosa-Walton County Line to Pensacola FL from 20 to
60 NM...

* Until 945 AM CDT.

* At 847 AM CDT, a strong thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located 11 nm west of Oriskany Reef, or 17 nm south
of Pensacola Pass, moving east at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Oriskany Reef.
properties.instruction:
Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.
